You're safe!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: Yes, I live on, though in disgrace.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: Until I bury the king's murderer, the traitor Sterens, with my own hands,{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: I cannot die, whatever may come.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}...I see.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: {f7:0380}I have a request I must make of you today, Princess Ashe, so I have intruded upon you, knowing full well how rude it is.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}What is it? This request of yours.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: Yes. It concerns the army gathered to strike down Sterens.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: We wish for you, as princess, to stand at its head and lead it.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Me...? But...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: Princess Ashe, I beg you, hear me out.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: {f7:E783}Sterens's rebels plunder town after town, and their outrages are too many to count.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: Many people are suffering under Sterens.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: What's more, the rebels use sinister monsters to wipe out the armies of the lords who resist them.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: {f7:E783}In the midst of this, we royalists have at last made contact with our comrades scattered across the land.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: And we have prepared a plan to retake the capital, which fell to Sterens... but...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: our forces are no more than even with the uprising army.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: {f7:E783}Honestly, as things stand, I cannot say whether we can defeat Sterens's army, with the monsters' power behind it...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: And so we humbly ask you to lend us your strength, Princess Ashe.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}My strength?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: Yes. Even now, many of Fangam's powerful lords{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}are still undecided whether to side with us or with the rebels.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: {f7:E783}If we proclaim at home and abroad that the princess is safe, and that the royal line continues as the rightful house of Bradarik,{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: we will surely win the support of the wavering lords and the neighboring nations!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: We... no, Fangam! Fangam needs Princess Ashe.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: I beg you, will you fight with us for the sake of Fangam?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}...Very well.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: Princess!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Carrying on the will of my father, the king, is my duty as princess.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Especially as long as I have loyal retainers like you, still sworn to the house of Bradarik...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}If someone like me will do, I will take on that responsibility.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I accept your request, General.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: Thank you, Princess Ashe. Your brave words give me great heart.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: Then I shall come for you tomorrow.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}All right...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:6580}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}Oh, you were here, {name:0080}. Sorry, I didn't notice you.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Not at all. Good luck tomorrow, okay?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah. Thanks...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{e0:4207}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah. ...But I turned him down.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:4307}{spk:0080}{n}I told him there's someone I love.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:4407}{spk:0080}{n}The prince asked what kind of person, so I...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:4507}{spk:0080}{n}I said it's someone who understands the real me, who's always supported me from the shadows...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}......{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:4607}{spk:0080}{n}I meant you, of course... {name:0080}.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}I'm happy to hear you say that, Ashe.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:4707}{spk:0080}{n}Thank you, really... I wanted to help you, Ashe.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:4807}{spk:0080}{n}...You're so kind, {name:0080}.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:4907}{spk:0080}{n}Always smiling and going along with my selfishness like that...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:4A07}{spk:0080}{n}Hey, even after peace comes back to this world, stay by my side...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:4B07}{spk:0080}{n}'Cause I want to be with you forever...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:4C07}{spk:0080}{n}Forever...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{e0:4D07}{fb:0280}{n}{e0:4D07}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:4E07}{spk:0080}{n}And, well, I'm thinking of accepting his proposal...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:4F07}{spk:0080}{n}I found out Prince Milias is actually sincere and kind,{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:5007}{spk:0080}{n}and I figured anyone Father chose for me couldn't be a bad person.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:5107}{spk:0080}{n}More than anything, I think with him, I could manage ruling the country from now on...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}I see...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:5207}{spk:0080}{n}But peace hasn't come back to this world yet, so I'll answer him after I've fulfilled my mission as a hero...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:5307}{spk:0080}{n}I'll see it through to the end, I promise, so don't worry.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:5407}{spk:0080}{n}...Thanks for everything up to now.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:5507}{spk:0080}{n}You've done so much for me, so I wanted you to be the first to hear this.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:5607}{spk:0080}{n}Well, see you, {name:0080}.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
